original_card.question: Can a legal decoder or coframe change improve the full signed moment, including changed helper targets?
methods: Construct and independently check one source-bound instance of the stated first experiment.
Seek an exact counterexample or target-specific complete-budget obstruction to that same proposed change.
original_card.acceptance_gate: A source-bound arbitrary-input identity and legal producer/consumer boundary with the complete paid and productive target invoice, including restoration, ownership, native alignment and extra charges. Price under the actual current model; historical ceiling.py assumptions must be established before use. A favorable optimistic relaxation keeps a route open but is not a completed supplier. A scoped local result remains useful; expansion requires the family-level budget gate.

first_step.inspect: Read revision 8, the selected review and live exact-source handoffs. Then follow this card's bounded first_experiment.
first_step.scope: Source-bound orientation only, not a supplier replay or theorem proof.

original_card.first_experiment: Price one complete changed itinerary with both paid and productive histograms. Check #5693/#5698 for overlap and their exact hypotheses before another coframe search. Use the signed invoice preflight where its boundary contract agrees; an inconclusive concave comparison is not a power crossing. Stop if an optimistic complete budget fails at the chosen target or native delivery remains unspecified.
original_card.bottleneck_link: Judge the actual current supplier contract and complete signed target/paid bill; frozen-profile ceilings require an applicability proof.
allowed_variations: One exact source head, helper/cut region or quantified proposition and changed hypothesis; check live handoffs first. Different seeds are not different scopes.

Treating an archived proposal or local numerical pass as complete supplier admission.

existing_checks.scope: Selected PR5599: complete helper-subspace construction and independent caller replay; five framework assumptions remain.
existing_checks.remaining: The next experiment must identify uncovered source-specific work. Successor archive intake does not transfer this admission.

actual_scope: Settle the OPEN item of PR2962 (research/decoder-certificate-ceilings, section 2.1) for the unit P120: compute the exact least number of maximal orthogonal sets meeting any k lines of E8 for k = 7, 8 and decide whether the uniform-weight fake decoder certifies the Theorem C value 360/17 for the larger family F'.
scope_change_reason: This is an open question posed by the predecessor package about ceilings for linear rank-counting certificates of the E8 decoder cost. It sharpens a proven certificate ceiling (24 to 360/17) rather than constructing or pricing a changed decoder.
bottleneck_link: Side result. It shows that the larger certificate family F' is no stronger than F on P120 under uniform weights, so linear rank-counting certificates of this shape still stop at 360/17, far below the targeted floor 72. No supplier, invoice or kappa is affected.
stop_rule: Stop after the exact P120 uniform ceiling and an E7 positive control. Do not extend to P112, non-uniform weights or the true decoder floor.
evidence: Standard-library verifier: E8 lines and 2025 frames, incidence counts 135/15/0, reflection automorphisms, Bonferroni pair caps, Caro-Wei orthogonal cores, orbit representatives and exhaustive extension search for k = 7, 8; exact Fraction ceiling; E7 control reproduces the predecessor MILP minima 55, 62, 68; RESULT.json byte equality.

ai_assistance: Independent human and formal proof-kernel review are unclaimed.

open_questions.question: Does 15968/757 also bound F' on P112?
open_questions.why_it_matters: It would settle the same OPEN item for the second unit, where the proven F' ceiling is still 15968/667.
open_questions.first_step: Compute exact least meets for k = 7, 8 over the 112 lines with automorphisms of P112 (the stabilizer of the removed frame), then reuse this pair-cap and orthogonal-core search.
open_questions.blocked_by: P112 is not line-transitive and its 1996 maximal orthogonal sets have mixed sizes; generators of the frame stabilizer are not supplied here.

open_questions.question: Is 360/17 the exact optimum of F' on P120 over non-uniform weights?
open_questions.why_it_matters: The uniform witness gives an upper ceiling; a dual certificate would show no F' certificate exceeds a smaller value.
open_questions.first_step: Write the F' ceiling as an orbit-reduced linear program over W(E8) orbits of line sets and solve it exactly.
open_questions.blocked_by: The F' constraint family ranges over all line sets; an exact orbit LP is not built here.

open_questions.question: Does the uniform F' ceiling on E6 or E7 improve beyond the predecessor's MILP-computed values with non-uniform weights?
open_questions.why_it_matters: On E7 the least meet 68 lies below the frame value 71, so uniform weights there cannot reach the Theorem C value 945/71.
open_questions.first_step: Use the same orbit LP on W(E7).
open_questions.blocked_by: No non-uniform witness or dual is computed.

claim_type: scoped proof with an exact finite certificate
